words.w: step out of the ivory tower
words.tr: 短语动词。走出象牙塔（指脱离脱离现实的学术或理想化环境，开始接触或面对真实世界）
words.ex: He decided to step out of the ivory tower and help poor communities.
words.ex_cn: 他决定走出象牙塔，去帮助贫困社区。
words.en: To leave the isolated world of academia or theory and engage with the practical, real world.

words.tr: adj. 忠诚的；
words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 找到他们真实的自我
words.ex: He meditates every day to find his true self.
words.ex_cn: 他每天冥想，以找到真正的自己。
words.en: To discover one's genuine identity or essence.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；除...之外
words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is without doubt the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is definitely true or will definitely happen

words.tr: n. 停滞，不景气
words.ex: The stagnancy of the economy has led to widespread unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 经济的停滞导致了广泛的失业。
words.en: Stagnancy refers to a state of inactivity or lack of development, often used to describe economic or social conditions.

words.tr: v. 使变得；
words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.tr: phrase. 严重的职业发展瓶颈；指在职业生涯中遇到的难以突破的障碍或限制
words.ex: She encountered a severe career bottleneck after years of working in the same position.
words.ex_cn: 她在同一职位工作多年后遇到了严重的职业瓶颈。
words.en: A significant obstacle or limitation in one's professional development or advancement.

words.tr: phrase. 危机破坏；指在危机期间故意进行的破坏行为
words.ex: The company faced a crisis sabotage when confidential documents were leaked.
words.ex_cn: 公司面临危机破坏，因为机密文件被泄露。
words.en: The act of deliberately causing a crisis or disrupting normal operations.

words.tr: phrase. 提升某人的知识；使知识逐步增长或升级
words.ex: He wants to escalate his knowledge by reading more books.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过读更多的书来提升自己的知识。
words.en: To increase or enhance one's knowledge and understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 各种不同的情况或环境
words.ex: The project was delayed due to various circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 由于各种情况，项目被推迟了。
words.en: Different situations or conditions that can affect an outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 普遍接受的智慧
words.ex: The common accepted wisdom is that early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
words.ex_cn: 普遍接受的智慧是早睡早起使人健康、富有和聪明。
words.en: The generally held belief or opinion that is widely accepted as true or valid.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为依据；基于……的理由；在……的前提下
words.ex: He was excused on the basis that he was ill.
words.ex_cn: conj. 基于他生病的理由，他被原谅了。
words.en: used to introduce the reason or principle that is the foundation for something

words.tr: phrase. 获得技能；学会本领
words.ex: He learns to acquire skills by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习来获得技能。
words.en: Gain new abilities or knowledge through learning or experience.

words.tr: n. 精疲力竭；过度劳累
words.ex: He feels burnout after working too many hours.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太久后感到精疲力尽。
words.en: Burnout is a state of emotional, physical, and mental exhaustion caused by excessive and prolonged stress. It occurs when you feel overwhelmed, emotionally drained, and unable to meet constant demands.

words.tr: phrase. 处理与同事之间的关系
words.ex: He tries to address relationship with colleagues by listening more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多倾听来改善与同事的关系。
words.en: To manage or handle interactions with coworkers.

words.tr: phrase. 似乎；看起来好像
words.ex: It seems that the weather is improving.
words.ex_cn: 看来天气在好转。
words.en: It appears or is believed to be true.

words.tr: phrase. 有助于…的；有益于…的
words.ex_cn: 新鲜空气有益于健康。
words.en: To help bring about or make something possible.

words.tr: phrase. 更新文化；使文化重新焕发活力；刷新培养物
words.ex: The museum aims to refresh cultures by showcasing contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆旨在通过展示当代艺术来更新文化。
words.en: To update or revitalize cultures, often by introducing new elements or perspectives.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事的；勉强的；不愿的
words.ex: He is reluctant to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 后者（指两者中后提到的那个）
words.ex: I like apples and oranges; the latter is my favorite.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子；后者是我最喜欢的。
words.en: Referring to the second of two mentioned things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 由于
words.ex: He was dismissed on the grounds of misconduct.
words.ex_cn: 他因行为不端被解雇。
words.en: used to indicate the reason or basis for something

words.tr: 对...无益；对...没有好处
words.ex: Eating too much candy will do no good to your teeth.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖果对你的牙齿没有好处。
words.en: To have no beneficial effect on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在一家公司任职；为某公司服务
words.ex: He serves in a company as a manager.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家公司担任经理。
words.en: To work for or be employed by a business.

words.w: before the final decision is made
words.tr: 在最终决定做出之前
words.ex: We need to gather more data before the final decision is made.
words.ex_cn: 在最终决定做出之前，我们需要收集更多的数据。
words.en: Prior to the making of the ultimate decision.

words.tr: phrase. 跳槽；频繁更换工作
words.ex: He is job hopping to find better pay.
words.ex_cn: 他频繁换工作以寻找更高的薪水。
words.en: The practice of frequently changing jobs, especially as a means of quick career advancement.

words.tr: phrase. 在新环境中的冒险或尝试；指进入陌生或未尝试过的领域进行探索或投资
words.ex: They venture in new settings to find better opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 他们进入新的环境以寻找更好的机会。
words.en: To take a risk or try something new in unfamiliar situations.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: 短语动词。熟练掌握；对……有很好的掌控能力
words.ex: He has a good command of English.
words.ex_cn: 他精通英语。
words.en: To be proficient in or have a thorough knowledge of something, especially a language or a skill.

words.tr: phrase. 保持竞争力；继续具有竞争优势
words.ex: She works hard to remain competitive.
words.ex_cn: 她努力工作以保持竞争力。
words.en: To continue to be as good as or better than others in a particular activity or market.

words.tr: 短语. 一场激烈的争论已经产生
words.ex: A heated controversy has arisen about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，已经引发了激烈的争议。
words.en: A serious public disagreement or debate has emerged.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极度地
words.ex: The weather is exceedingly cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气极其寒冷。
words.en: To a very great degree; extremely.

words.tr: phrase. 最新的技能；与时俱进的技能
words.ex: She attended several workshops to keep her up-to-date skills.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了几个研讨会以保持她的最新技能。
words.en: Skills that are current and incorporate the latest knowledge or techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 必须指出；应当注意到
words.ex: It must be noted that the results are preliminary.
words.ex_cn: 必须注意的是，这些结果是初步的。
words.en: It is important to be aware that

words.tr: phrase. 众所周知；正如我们所知
words.ex: As we all know, the Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 众所周知，地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that is already known or accepted by everyone

words.w: constant practice helps make an expert
words.tr: 短语. 持续的练习有助于造就专家
words.uk: ˈkɒnstənt ˈpræktɪs helps meɪk ən ˈekspɜːt
words.us: ˈkɑːnstənt ˈpræktɪs hɛlps meɪk ən ˈɛks.pɜːrt
words.ex: Constant practice helps make an expert.
words.ex_cn: 持续练习有助于成为专家。
words.en: Regular and repeated activity leads to skill and mastery.

words.w: they can not a nor can they
words.tr: 语法错误的句子，无法构成完整语义。正确形式可能为 'They cannot do A, nor can they do B'（他们不能做A，也不能做B）
words.uk: ðeɪ kɑːn nɒt ə nɔː kæn ðeɪ
words.us: ðeɪ kæn nɑːt ə nɔr kæn ðeɪ
words.ex: They can not run, nor can they jump.
words.ex_cn: 他们不能跑，也不能跳。
words.en: They are unable to do option A and are also unable to do option B.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏安全；安全保障不足；不安全感
words.ex: There is a lack of security in the old building.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧楼缺乏安全保障。
words.en: The state of not being protected against danger or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 得出结论；结束；推断出
words.ex: He will conclude the meeting with a summary.
words.ex_cn: 他将以一个总结来结束会议。
words.en: To bring something to an end or reach a decision after considering the facts.

words.tr: adv. 尽管如此；
words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.tr: adv. 不可避免地；
words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: 短语，表示‘可以是 A 或者 B’，用于描述两种可能性中的一种
words.uk: kæn ˈaɪðə r eɪ ɔːr biː
words.ex: You can either walk or take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你可以走路去，也可以坐公交车。
words.en: One of two options (A or B) is possible.

words.tr: adj. 似乎合理的；看似真实的；似乎可信的；看似真实的；
words.ex: His excuse sounded plausible.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口听起来似乎合理。
words.en: An explanation or statement that is plausible seems likely to be true or valid.

words.tr: phrase. 不太可能做某事；发生的可能性很小
words.ex: He is not likely to attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: v. 他不太可能参加明天的会议。
words.en: phrase. If you say that something is not likely to happen, you mean that it will probably not happen.
